verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents instant creation of virtual cards for the whole team, with spend limits and built-in expense controls or policies. Its MCP server can also issue new virtual cards with custom names, spending limits and reset intervals, so a card can be labeled and capped for a purpose. However, nothing shows locking a card to a single vendor or merchant category such as ad platforms, so purpose scoping is only implied through naming and limits. Missing for 10: vendor/merchant locking, merchant-category restrictions, an explicit purpose-scoped card workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
